title: Every storm since 1851: where hurricanes form, where they hit, and are they getting stronger?
excerpt: I mapped all 13,186 tropical cyclones in NOAA's global archive, from depressions to Category 5 typhoons. The number of storms has not changed since 1980, but more of them reach Category 4 or 5 and they peak further from the equator. Before satellites, the record misses too many storms to say much more.
seo_description: Every hurricane, typhoon and cyclone since 1851 on one map: where they form, where they hit, and whether they are getting stronger.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Every storm since 1851' in black on pale paper, beside a Pacific-centred world map of thousands of storm tracks coloured from blue to deep red and plum by strength, densest east of the Philippines. Text: 13,186 tropical cyclones, by strength; Category 4+ share 12% in the 1980s, 23% in the 2010s.
